description: This PHP script manages the display of help pages in the TestLink open-source project. It initializes parameters, sets up the Smarty template engine, and renders the specified help page based on user input.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic empty class used as a container for properties in PHP.

classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for template rendering.

classes.description: Class representing input parameters, particularly for parsing GET/POST variables.

methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request arguments for help page display, including 'help' and 'locale'.
